content: If the configuration parameter XfrmDevErrorDetect is enabled, all parameters of API E2EXf_<transformerId> (see SWS_E2EXf_00032) shall be checked for being in the allowed range. In case of an error the mode switch shall not be executed, the error shall be reported to the Default Error Tracer with the value E2EXF_E_PARAM re sp. E2EXF_E_PARAM_POINTER in case of a pointer argument and the routine shall return the value E_SAFETY_HARD_RUNTIMEERROR.
